title: Project Kei QQ Bridge local configuration

QQBOT_APPID.description: QQ Bot App ID; stored only in the persistent local .env.

QQBOT_SECRET.description: QQ Bot App Secret; stored only in the persistent local .env.

QQBOT_ALLOW_FROM.description: Comma-separated C2C allowlist; stored only in the persistent local .env.

QQBOT_REPLY_WITH_VOICE.description: Explicit non-secret opt-in for one voice attachment after eligible conversation replies.

QQBOT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_CAPABILITY.description: Non-secret operator declaration of the bot's QQ C2C media-upload permission; never inferred or actively probed.
